fit_rationale: Fit Score: 7.2/10 — Candidate demonstrates strong baseline coverage with confirmed Figma proficiency, user research experience, and accessibility training. The primary gap is in the minimum 3-year professional UX/UI design requirement—candidate has 1.7 cumulative years of dedicated UX practice (1.3 contract + 0.4 intern). All statutory checks are procedural matters for initial screening.

requirements.requirement_text: Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UX/UI work across web and mobile platforms. We want to see your process (research → ideation → testing → iteration), not just final screens.
requirements.strength_note: Candidate delivered full end-to-end UX for a council community portal from discovery through developer handoff, and improved fintech onboarding completion from 34% to 71%, demonstrating iterative process with measurable outcomes.

requirements.requirement_text: Tools: Advanced proficiency in Figma (including component libraries, auto layout, variables, and Dev Mode). Experience with prototyping and user testing tools (e.g., Maze, UserTesting, Optimal Workshop).
requirements.strength_note: Candidate has 2+ years of daily Figma use across contract and intern roles, plus documented use of Maze and UserTesting for prototyping and user testing.

requirements.requirement_text: Research Skills: Demonstrated experience planning and conducting user research, and translating findings into design decisions. We value designers who can run their own research, not just consume research reports.
requirements.strength_note: Candidate independently conducted user research with 15 community members for a community website redesign, and completed General Assembly UX Immersive training covering end-to-end research methods.

requirements.requirement_text: Accessibility: Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 AA standards and inclusive design principles, with evidence of applying them in shipped products.
requirements.strength_note: Candidate holds current accessibility certification from Interaction Design Foundation (2024), demonstrating formal training in WCAG standards and inclusive design principles.

requirements.requirement_text: Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively within Agile squads, including constructive collaboration with product managers, engineers, and content designers.
requirements.strength_note: Candidate managed cross-functional delivery at Bright Pixel Studio, including direct stakeholder scoping and developer handoff, plus team management experience from legal background.

evidence_downgrade.reason: Evidence does not prove Agile squad cross-functional collaboration with PMs, engineers, and content designers. Solo contractor managing clients + legal team management ≠ Agile squad immersion.

requirements.requirement_text: Communication: Ability to articulate design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including at senior leadership level.
requirements.strength_note: Candidate's corporate law background included advising ASX-listed clients and managing multinational stakeholder communications, with explicit recognition for translating complex information into clear client advice.

requirements.requirement_text: Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional UX/UI design experience (agency, in-house, or contract). Financial services, healthcare, or other regulated-industry experience is highly regarded but not essential.
requirements.evidence_source: candidate_profile.work_history[0] + work_history[1] (1.3 years contract + 0.4 years intern = 1.7 cumulative professional UX)

threshold_analysis.units: years of professional UX/UI design experience
